description: This file defines the Settings class used in the RomRaider project, managing configuration parameters, user interface settings, file paths, logger configurations, and other constants. It appears to be a central configuration class for the application.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A central class managing application-wide configuration, constants, and user interface settings for RomRaider, including file paths, visual themes, logger configurations, and user preferences.

methods.name: getRecentVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the recent version string recorded in settings.

methods.name: setRecentVersion
methods.description: Sets the recent version string in settings.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the user locale for number formatting and language preferences.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the current user locale setting.

methods.name: isUsNumberFormat
methods.description: Checks if the number format follows US conventions.

methods.name: getLoggerPort
methods.description: Returns the configured logger port.

methods.name: setLoggerPort
methods.description: Sets the logger port.

methods.name: getLoggerProtocol
methods.description: Returns the communication protocol used by the logger.

methods.name: setLoggerProtocol
methods.description: Sets the communication protocol for the logger.

methods.name: getLoggerDefinitionFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path of the logger ECU definition.

methods.name: setLoggerDefinitionFilePath
methods.description: Sets the file path of the logger ECU definition.

methods.name: getLoggerOutputDirPath
methods.description: Retrieves the directory path for logger output files.

methods.name: setLoggerOutputDirPath
methods.description: Sets the directory path for logger output files.

methods.name: getLoggerWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the logger window.

methods.name: setLoggerWindowSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the logger window.

methods.name: getLoggerWindowLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the logger window on screen.

methods.name: setLoggerWindowLocation
methods.description: Sets the location of the logger window.

methods.name: isLoggerWindowMaximized
methods.description: Checks if the logger window is maximized.

methods.name: setLoggerWindowMaximized
methods.description: Sets the maximized state of the logger window.

methods.name: getLoggerProfileFilePath
methods.description: Returns the profile file path for logger configuration.

methods.name: setLoggerProfileFilePath
methods.description: Sets the profile file path for logger configuration.

methods.name: getLoggerConnectionProperties
methods.description: Retrieves the connection properties for the logger.

methods.name: setLoggerConnectionProperties
methods.description: Sets the connection properties for the logger.

methods.name: getLoggerEcuDefinitionMap
methods.description: Returns the map of ECU definitions used for logging.

methods.name: setLoggerEcuDefinitionMap
methods.description: Sets the map of ECU definitions for logging.

methods.name: getLoggerPluginPorts
methods.description: Returns configured plugin ports for the logger.

methods.name: setLoggerPluginPorts
methods.description: Sets the plugin ports for the logger.

methods.name: getLoggerSelectedTabIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected logger tab index.

methods.name: setLoggerSelectedTabIndex
methods.description: Sets the selected logger tab index.

methods.name: getLoggerDebuggingLevel
methods.description: Returns the current debugging level for logger.

methods.name: setLoggerDebuggingLevel
methods.description: Sets the debugging level for logger.

methods.name: getTransportProtocol
methods.description: Returns the transport protocol used.

methods.name: setTransportProtocol
methods.description: Sets the transport protocol.

methods.name: getJ2534Device
methods.description: Returns the J2534 device identifier.

methods.name: setJ2534Device
methods.description: Sets the J2534 device identifier.

methods.name: setTableClipboardFormat
methods.description: Sets the clipboard format for tables.

methods.name: getTableClipboardFormat
methods.description: Gets the current clipboard format for tables.

methods.name: setTableHeader
methods.description: Sets the table header string.

methods.name: getTableHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the table header string.

methods.name: setTable1DHeader
methods.description: Sets the header for 1D tables.

methods.name: getTable1DHeader
methods.description: Gets the header for 1D tables.

methods.name: setTable2DHeader
methods.description: Sets the header for 2D tables.

methods.name: getTable2DHeader
methods.description: Gets the header for 2D tables.

methods.name: setTable3DHeader
methods.description: Sets the header for 3D tables.

methods.name: getTable3DHeader
methods.description: Gets the header for 3D tables.

methods.name: setDefaultFormat
methods.description: Resets table headers and formats to default values.

methods.name: setAirboysFormat
methods.description: Sets table headers and formats to Airboys style.

methods.name: getEditorIconScale
methods.description: Returns the icon scale for the editor toolbar.

methods.name: setEditorIconScale
methods.description: Sets the icon scale for the editor toolbar.

methods.name: getTableIconScale
methods.description: Returns the icon scale for table toolbars.

methods.name: setTableIconScale
methods.description: Sets the icon scale for table toolbars.

methods.name: isOpenExpanded
methods.description: Checks if tables are expanded by default.

methods.name: setOpenExpanded
methods.description: Sets the default expanded state for tables.

methods.name: isShowTableToolbarBorder
methods.description: Checks if table toolbar borders are shown.

methods.name: setShowTableToolbarBorder
methods.description: Configures whether to show table toolbar borders.

methods.name: isAlwaysOpenTableAtZero
methods.description: Checks if tables are always opened at zero index.

methods.name: setAlwaysOpenTableAtZero
methods.description: Configures tables to always open at zero index.

methods.name: isScaleHeadersAndData
methods.description: Checks if headers and data should be scaled.

methods.name: setScaleHeadersAndData
methods.description: Configures scaling of headers and data.

methods.name: isColorAxis
methods.description: Checks if color axis visualization is enabled.

methods.name: setColorAxis
methods.description: Enables or disables color axis visualization.
